title: mentha gentilis var. crispa
intro: Mentha gentilis var. crispa, commonly known as Bergamot mint, is a variety of mint plant characterized by its distinctive, curled or crisped leaves. This plant is valued for its numerous health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, relieving digestive issues, and providing antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Mentha gentilis var. crispa are attributed to its calming and antispasmodic effects, which can help to soothe anxiety and muscle cramps. The bioactive constituents of this plant include menthone, menthol, and limonene, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
